parent_objective: design frozen-M399 residual-head objective using regenerated M919 targets
blocked_by: M919 passed expanded target generation, but regenerated target residual objective is not yet designed

public_gates: M920 must train only a residual head in the future M921 design
M920 must keep M880 exact compatibility, replay, PPO, and promotion blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run M880 exact compatibility

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_target_objective: design residual objective for regenerated targets
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs frozen-M399 residual-head objective after M919 produced a source-diverse regenerated target corpus
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: objective design only; no training, exact compatibility, replay, PPO, driver improvement claim, or promotion
stop_condition: stop if the design updates the actor backbone
stop if the design admits M880 exact compatibility before objective metrics pass
stop if replay, PPO, or promotion is attempted
fallback_plan: if M921 finds an admitted alpha, route to exact no-update compatibility design
if M921 improves target loss but not tail metrics, route to regenerated-target objective audit
if M921 breaks normal retention, route to residual trust-region or target-action cap design

hypothesis: M919 regenerated targets justify a frozen-M399 residual-head objective probe, but only after pre-registering normal-retention and low-tail candidate gates.
success_criteria: M920 pre-registers regenerated target action loss and full-corpus normal retention
M920 pre-registers candidate alpha gates before M921 training
M920 keeps exact compatibility replay PPO and promotion blocked
failure_criteria: M920 admits exact compatibility before objective metrics
M920 starts replay PPO or promotion
decision_rule: M920 may only design regenerated-target residual objective training. It must not train or run exact compatibility until M921 executes and passes objective gates.
